ns2:course.label: Complex Variables I
ns2:course.description: Topics include the Cauchy theory, harmonic functions, entire and meromorphic functions, and the Riemann mapping theorem. Prerequisite: MATH 446 and MATH 447, or MATH 448.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MATH 446 and MATH 447, or MATH 448.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC or MS: Financial Engineering.
